views.name: paper_author_link
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.paperId AS paperId,
  a.authorId AS authorId,
  a.authorName AS authorName,
  p.title AS title,
  p.year AS year,
  p.venueId AS venueId,
  p.journalId AS journalId
FROM writes w
JOIN paper p ON w.paperId = p.paperId
JOIN author a ON w.authorId = a.authorId
grain: one row per paper-author pair (paperId, authorId)
views.description: Denormalized relation linking papers to their authors with paper and author identifiers and names, plus paper basic metadata to support filtering/grouping by paper attributes.

views.name: paper_citation_category
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.paperId AS paperId,
  COALESCE(p.numCiting, 0) AS numCiting,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(p.numCiting, 0) = 0 THEN 'none'
    WHEN COALESCE(p.numCiting, 0) BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN 'low'
    WHEN COALESCE(p.numCiting, 0) BETWEEN 6 AND 20 THEN 'moderate'
    WHEN COALESCE(p.numCiting, 0) BETWEEN 21 AND 100 THEN 'high'
    ELSE 'very_high'
  END AS citation_category
FROM paper p
views.description: Assigns a categorical citation label based on a paper's raw citation count (NULL treated as 0). Keeps original numeric measure plus derived category for easy reporting and filtering.

views.name: author_coauthors
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  a1.authorId AS authorId,
  a2.authorId AS coauthorId,
  a2.authorName AS coauthorName,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.paperId) AS joint_paper_count
FROM writes w1
JOIN writes w2
  ON w1.paperId = w2.paperId
  AND w1.authorId != w2.authorId
JOIN author a1 ON w1.authorId = a1.authorId
JOIN author a2 ON w2.authorId = a2.authorId
JOIN paper p ON w1.paperId = p.paperId
GROUP BY a1.authorId, a2.authorId, a2.authorName
views.description: For each author, list distinct coauthors and count of joint papers. Useful for finding one-step coauthor networks and strength of connections.

views.name: paper_citation_level_lookup
views.body_sql:

  p.paperId AS paperId,
  p.numCitedBy AS numCitedBy,
  CASE
    WHEN p.numCitedBy IS NULL THEN 'unknown'
    WHEN p.numCitedBy >= 100 THEN 'high'
    WHEN p.numCitedBy >= 20 THEN 'medium'
    WHEN p.numCitedBy >= 1 THEN 'low'
    ELSE 'none'
  END AS citation_level
FROM paper p
views.description: Assigns a citation-level label to papers based on raw numCitedBy thresholds; keeps raw measure and classification rule generalized for reuse.

views.name: venue_paper_assignment

  v.venueId,
  v.venueName,
  p.title,

FROM paper AS p
LEFT JOIN venue AS v

views.name: venue_paper_counts_base
views.body_sql:

  COUNT(DISTINCT p.paperId) AS distinct_paper_count
FROM

LEFT JOIN
  paper p
ON
  p.venueId = v.venueId
GROUP BY
  v.venueId
views.description: Aggregated counts of distinct papers per venueId (does not exclude venues with zero papers; designed to be left-joined to venue for full coverage). Returns raw distinct counts per venueId.

views.description: Aggregated list of authors (ids and names) per paper and the number of distinct authors. Useful to check co-authorship, author counts, and to filter papers having a specific set or count of co-authors.

views.name: paper_author_counts

GROUP BY

views.description: For each paper, the total number of distinct authors associated with that paper. Keeps paper-level identifiers and raw author count so downstream queries can compute co-author counts (e.g., subtract 1 for a specific author).

views.name: paper_keyphrases_datasets_47
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.paperId AS paperId,
  pk.keyphraseId AS keyphraseId,
  k.keyphraseName AS keyphraseName,

LEFT JOIN dataset d ON pd.datasetId = d.datasetId

views.name: paper_impact_label
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.paperId AS paperId,
  p.numCitedBy AS numCitedBy,
  CASE
    WHEN p.numCitedBy IS NULL THEN 'unknown'
    WHEN p.numCitedBy >= 100 THEN 'very_high'
    WHEN p.numCitedBy >= 50 THEN 'high'
    WHEN p.numCitedBy >= 20 THEN 'moderate'
    WHEN p.numCitedBy >= 5 THEN 'low'
    WHEN p.numCitedBy >= 0 THEN 'very_low'
    ELSE 'unknown'
  END AS impact_label
FROM paper p
grain: one row per paperId with its raw citation count and categorical label
views.description: Maps raw citation counts (numCitedBy) to an externally defined categorical impact label. Keeps thresholds as configurable question operations but provides the mapping column name for downstream queries.
